description: Awen 1.0.5 - Real-Time YouTube Cloud Sync, Obsidian Aesthetic & Mascot Player

changelog.title: Real-Time YouTube Cloud Playback Sync
items: Real-time watchtime synchronization directly with YouTube servers under your logged-in Google account.
Automatic background tracking feeds YouTube's recommendation algorithm with accurate playback duration and watch signals.
Continuous 10-second watchtime heartbeats with automatic state handling for play, pause, and track transitions.

changelog.title: YouTube Cloud History Browsing
items: Toggle seamlessly between Local History and YouTube Cloud Watch History in the History screen.
Dedicated refresh button to query and fetch latest cloud watch records on demand.
Persists user preference automatically with zero disruption for logged-out users.

changelog.title: Obsidian Crystal Aesthetic & Mascot Player
items: New obsidian crystal app icon and brand emblem design.
Animated dancing girl mascot on the mini player that dances during playback, bounces on entrance, and pouts when paused.
Enhanced SAPISID authentication and Google cookie support.
